method: SEED for U5 (in-tournament player form). wc_goals/wc_assists/wc_minutes are FACTUAL from data/manual/results.json match notes through MD2 (matches 1-44); wc_xg/wc_xa/wc_shots are CONSERVATIVE ESTIMATES (~goals discounted toward process) pending real fbref/Opta WC xG. REFRESH each matchday in the daily research step (RUNBOOK §2): add real per-player WC xG/xA/shots + every fantasy-relevant performer, and fill the `teams` block (wc_xg_for/against) for U2. The model shrinks the club-season per-90 toward these, minutes-weighted (2 games barely move it), leaning on xG over goals so finishing heat regresses.
sources: fbref.com / understat.com / fotmob.com (WC per-match xG — to be pulled in daily research)

teams._note: U2 opponent-adjusted team form: per nation {wc_xg_for, wc_xg_against, matches, opponents} — tournament TOTALS (not per-game). SEED: goal-difference-consistent xG estimates for the 7 contenders with two verified results; add the rest + real xG in daily research. The model credits xG-difference vs the strength of opponents faced (beating Curaçao ≠ beating France), shrunk by matches, as a SMALL post-calibration strength offset.
